stage0097_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$クィーン$$
「Are you dissatisfied with this outcome?」

stage0097_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$クィーン$$
「The future mankind chose...
　It certainly does run against Chrono's doctrine.」

stage0097_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$キング$$
「It's the reformists who deserve our hatred...」

stage0097_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$キング$$
「To think that behind $c's existence,
　they were helping prepare for $$時空修復$$...」

stage0097_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$クィーン$$
「We too bear some responsibility
　for failing to see through that.」

stage0097_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$キング$$
「...But that will bring about
　the worst possible outcome for mankind.」

stage0097_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$クィーン$$
「This is beyond even our ability to interfere.
　Let's leave the rest to that one, our proxy.」

stage0097_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$キング$$
「$$ガドライト$$ and $$アドヴェント$$...
　Which one will win...?」

stage0097_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カレン$$
「What are you talking about?
　$$ガドライト$$ was our enemy too,
　so of course we'd back you up.」

stage0097_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$n
「The reason I've been able to fight
　until today is thanks to everyone.」

stage0097_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$n
「If I'd been alone, I'm sure I'd have lost
　to fear and sunk into the same despair he did...」

stage0097_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$n
「If I hadn't joined $c...
　No... if I hadn't transferred to Jindai High,
　I wouldn't be who I am today...」

stage0097_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hearing you say that,
　pushing $$宗介$$ onto you wasn't a mistake after all.」

stage0097_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$宗介$$
「I was... the one pushed on him...?」

stage0097_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh... uhehe...
　It's just a figure of speech.」

stage0097_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$n
「I knew it! So that's how it was!」

stage0097_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wha...! Sorry, $n!
　For dumping something troublesome on you!」

stage0097_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Guess that's what they call a blessing in disguise.」

stage0097_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シン$$
「Even if you call it an 'injury,' I'd say that's more like a severe one.」

stage0097_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, it's fine, isn't it!
　All's well that ends well!」

stage0097_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's not a line you get to say, when you're the one who caused it!」

stage0097_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All right, all right, that's enough of this topic.
　$$宗介$$ seems pretty hurt by it too.」

stage0097_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm... a nuisance... a hindrance... dead weight... an unwanted child...」

stage0097_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ワッ太$$
（I don't think that's really surprising at this point.）

stage0097_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$正太郎$$
（That's... definitely something you shouldn't say.）

stage0097_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm... a broken needle bound for the heart... a giant dud bomb...」

stage0097_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$n
「Don't worry about it, $$宗介$$.
　I'm glad I got to be your friend.」

stage0097_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$n
「Not just you.
　Meeting everyone in the Volunteer Club,
　and everyone in $c too.」

stage0097_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$n
「Of course, that includes you too, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0097_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「Thank you, everyone.
　I look forward to more of the same.」

stage0097_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$桂$$
「Still, the road ahead's a rough one.
　After all, you've been marked by the $$スフィア$$.」

stage0097_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$キラ$$
「I knew that defeating the owner
　lets you take the $$スフィア$$, but I didn't
　know that applied even without a Reactor...」

stage0097_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What's more, this time, the $$スフィア$$
　moved before the Reactor was even defeated.」

stage0097_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I wonder if it's because $$ジェニオン$$
　is modeled after $$ジェミニア$$, after all?」

stage0097_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（A mobile weapon built to steal $$スフィア$$s...
　Reminds me of $$アサキム$$'s Shurouga...）

stage0097_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$キラ$$
「$n, you're going to keep fighting in $$ジェニオン$$, right?」

stage0097_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I've heard your resolve.
　Once things settle down, ask Dr. $$トライア$$
　about the $$スフィア$$'s properties.」

stage0097_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$桂$$
（Well... as for 《$$スフィアの反作用$$》,
　there's no point talking about it now.）

stage0097_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（For now, let's have those of us
　around him keep watch over that.）

stage0097_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$n...
　Your revenge is over now, isn't it...）

stage0097_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$スズネ$$
（But, $$ガドライト$$'s final words were...）

stage0097_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...$n.
　If you're going to keep fighting, don't you think
　your partner deserves a word about it?」

stage0097_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... I look forward to working with you.」

stage0097_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's do our best, $n.
　So everyone can get back to Jindai High together.」

stage0097_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
Geminis
「Major $$アンナロッタ$$...
　What should we do now?」

stage0097_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「The captain left us orders
　to retreat, in case something happened.」

stage0097_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「We'll gather our remaining forces and withdraw from Earth.」

stage0097_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
Geminis
「But where are we even supposed to go...!?」

stage0097_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
Geminis
「We don't even have a home planet to return to anymore...」

stage0097_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Even so, we must survive.
　If only to preserve the Geminaid bloodline.」

stage0097_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
Geminis
「Major $$アンナロッタ$$!
　We'll hold them off here!
　Fall back, quickly!」

stage0097_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
???
「So, this is as far as you go.」

stage0097_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Geminis, in one hit...!」

stage0097_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
???
「I haven't killed them.
　My mission is only the execution
　of you, $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.」

stage0097_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
???
「The Geminaid, a race of pure matrilineal inheritance...
　The last surviving woman of that line...
　Execute you, and that bloodline ends.」

stage0097_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
???
「This is the fate of those who defied heaven's will.」

stage0097_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
???
「When the time comes, I'll carry out my other mission...」

stage0097_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What is it, $$ＡＧ$$?
　Calling me out here specially...」

stage0097_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... I just thought I'd offer a word of congratulations.」

stage0097_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That's premature.
　We've only overcome one threat, nothing more.」

stage0097_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But I do appreciate the thought.
　Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0097_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... no need to say anything unnecessary.」

stage0097_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I'm glad. With Master $$ハサウェイ$$
　getting Master $$クェス$$ back,
　even the worst future for Master $$ブライト$$ was avoided...」

stage0097_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, I'll add the 200 Z-Chips
　from Master $$ハサウェイ$$'s joy to the squad's stock.」

stage0097_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, straying from the 'correct history'
　that $$フル・フロンタル$$ spoke of,
　where will the world head next, I wonder...」

stage0097_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You did it, $n.
　By absorbing that thing called the $$スフィア$$,
　$$ジェニオン$$ is complete.」

stage0097_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　It seems $$ジェニオン$$'s GAI Mode
　was its true form all along.」

stage0097_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But since extracting $$次元力$$ was unstable,
　a limiter like that one was necessary.」

stage0097_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$n
「An engine that generates vast $$次元力$$, the $$スフィア$$...
　So this makes $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s operating time infinite now.」

stage0097_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$スフィア$$'s operation is affected by the pilot's mental state.
　So, GAI Mode should still be used
　only when it truly counts.」

stage0097_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$n
「Understood.
　The true $$ジェニオン$$... I'll master it, no matter what.」

stage0097_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Leave the maintenance to me!
　I'll analyze that $$スフィア$$
　as far as I possibly can too.」

stage0097_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$n
「Thank you.
　Thanks to you, I've been able to fight until today.」

stage0097_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ダリー$$
「That's great, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You've been working hard right alongside $n
　this whole time too.」

stage0097_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ギミー$$
「But hey, that $$スフィア$$'s name, 'Bickering Twins',
　can't something be done about that?」

stage0097_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ダリー$$
「It is a bit bothersome, isn't it...」

stage0097_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You two are such a close pair of twins, after all.」

stage0097_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Things too alike repel each other...
　And so it was with Mars and $$マーグ#pilot$$...」

stage0097_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...For now, let's see to the task at hand.
　Are you ready, Master $$ギミー$$, Master $$ダリー$$?」

stage0097_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all today too!」
